The [[Wind Rider Polymock Piece]] is one of the 18 pieces that a player can pick while playing [[Polymock]].

When using this piece, you take the [[Wind Rider Form]].

[[Category:Polymock pieces]]

==Acquisition==
This piece drops as a reward from the [[Chest of Burrows]] and [[Murakai's Chest]].
